_about: The planting of a paddy in Xóm Ruộng (src/core/planting.js; docs/PLANTING.md). A plot is an array of seedlings: one seedling on each half block, rows along z and columns along x. The size of a plot comes from the level of math.mul.10 that the learner chooses (the factor ranges of data/skills.json). levels: for each level of the skill, bundle (the size of a bundle of the seedbed: 'row' for one row of the plot, or a number), example (the farmer plants the first row as an example), hard (the part of the plots with a hard fact, a factor of six to nine), and forms (the kinds of task at that level). The form 'divide' comes only when math.div.10 is open. set: the plots of a set. offers: the plots that are ready at the same time (the child chooses one); bigger: a bigger plot on offer at these levels, for pride (never needed). boxes: the days to the next check of a fact after each clean success (rule 24); a missed fact comes back in the same set, after 'again' plots. growth: the stage of a planted plot after these game days. events: the small events of a set (at most one in a set, never the same in two sets in a row), and chance (the chance of one event in a set). season: the season of a planted plot (a hook for the harvest of a later issue).
